sentences.text: THIS CRL.P IS FILED UNDER SECTION 438 OF CR.PC PRAYING TO PASS AN ORDER, DIRECTING THE PETITIONERS TO BE RELEASED ON ANTICIPATORY BAIL, IN THE EVENT OF THEIR ARREST ON THE COMPLAINT FILED BY SUMIT CHOPRA OF MY PREFERRED TRANSFORMATION AND HOSPITALITY PRIVATE LIMITED BEFORE THE BADSHAHPUR POLICE STATION, GURUGRAM PRESUMABLY FOR THE OFFENCES PUNISHABLE UNDER SECTION 420 OF IPC.

THIS PETITION, COMING ON FOR ORDERS, THIS DAY,
THE COURT MADE THE FOLLOWING:
 ORDER
This petition is preferred by the petitioners seeking transit anticipatory bail, apprehending arrest by the Police attached to Badshahpur Police Station, Gurugram, State of Haryana.

2. It is stated that the petitioners have a reasonable apprehension of their arrest by the Police based on the complaint of one Sumit Chopra field on behalf of 'My Preferred Transformation and Hospitality Private Limited'.

entities.text: My Preferred Transformation and Hospitality Private Limited
entities.label: ORG

sentences.text:
It is submitted that the concerned Police have issued notice to the petitioners to participate in the enquiry and therefore, petitioners are likely to be arrested.
3. Petitioners have approached the learned Sessions Judge seeking similar prayer and the said petition NC: 2023:KHC:21028 has been rejected on the ground that, so far the Police have not registered any case against the petitioners and therefore, question of arresting them does not arise.

It is no doubt true that the learned Sessions Judge has mentioned Crime No.11/2023 as the crime registered against the petitioners, but it is submitted that the said case was registered against the complainant on a complaint lodged by petitioner No.1.
The learned Sessions Judge, while rejecting the petition has observed that petitioners are habitual in cheating and they have cheated crores of amount in the hotel business.
The said observations made by the learned Sessions Judge, even before registration of any case against the petitioners, was not warranted.
4. Considering that there is no case registered against the petitioners, at this stage, this Court does not find any justification to grant the relief sought.
However, if any case is registered, it is open for the petitioners to approach the concerned Court for appropriate relief.
With the above observations, petition is disposed of.
